reviews.review: Fantactic and fun cooperative multiplayer game. Each mission type and biom has a different feel and even just dancing, drinking and waving the beards around is fun. Solo missions are also great, but with friends it's always better.

Update, 300 or so Hours in. The game can hardly call itself "Early Access anymore content- or gameplay-wise. As far as Coop shooters go, it is feature complete the "end game" update that added Deep Dives and added extra side quests show that dev team is constalntly trying to find out and expand any part of the whole that is still not quite there.. 

update: 37 hours in, its still rather fun. As far as "early access" goes DRG not only has all the core gameplay elements in, but also rather nice amount of content. 

There are five different mission types: mining expedition, point extraction, salvage operation, egg hunt and extermination. I like some more than others but every one is noticably different. All missions are available from the get go on public servers and the game guides you through them one-by-one if you do your own lobby.

Likewise there are 7 or so distinctly different biomes where the randomgenerated maps are. aside from visuals they differ in terrain and hazards. Im not a fan of few of them but that isnt to say there isnt a lot of varying content.

There are 4 classes of dwarves, and they complement each other very well and each one of them can work solo as well, so mixing and matching teams is totally feasible- unless you are palying highest difficulty dont expect to be a drag for the team even if you take a duplicate class.

In its current state expect to "see" most mission/map combos by around 25-35 hours in depending on your play style.  

All in all there is very few bad things to say about DRG, which is weird. Only downside is sometimes the random generator just decides to show you a middle finger on map generation, but even that is few and far between.

Update: they added a second set of primary and secondary weapons for all classes and aside for 1-2 weak weapons theyre all awesome. 98 hours in the game stays fun and every update so far has taken it to "more fun" direction.

Very solid game for EA title.
